title: MeltyLancer: Re-inforce (Demo)

overview:
That "Raising Game" Powers Up on the Sega Saturn!

Event
Plenty of events tied to the Sega Saturn's internal clock

Tactics
The battle system is a semi-real-time battle.
Those characters talk up a storm!

Minigame
In the minigames, chibi characters move around comically!

High Quality Graphics
Packed with an abundance of high-quality graphics
